_comment: Goals for the executive scorecard (owner decision 2026-10-13). Rates, not totals: the dashboard multiplies per-rep rates by the number of reps in config/sales-reps.json and by the length of the selected period, then scales to the elapsed portion of the period for the Met / On Track / Missed pill. Talk time is in minutes. A KPI missing from every list shows 'Goal not set' and no pill.
